ValidationRule.description: Since the Company field is filled for 'Modon - Egypt', you must also provide Organization ID, Owner Name, and Email.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Company)), ISPICKVAL(Source_Entity__c, 'Modon - Egypt'), OR( ISBLANK(Organization_ID__c), ISBLANK(Owner__c), ISBLANK(Email) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Since the Company field is filled, you must also provide Organization ID, Owner Name, and Email.
